title: UAAP: Luis Pablo delivers timely boost as La Salle chases Final Four

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–As the UAAP Season 89 Final Four race heats up, defending champion La Salle needs all hands on deck for the stretch run. Luis Pablo answered the call, helping keep the Green Archers in the hunt for a semifinal spot with an 84-69 rout of Adamson on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The budding big man turned in 14 points and seven rebounds as La Salle improved to 7-5 and strengthened its bid for a Final Four berth.
